M1.what: CL4 on the 400 tasks, TensorFold 1.2.5 (tf125) vs 0.6.0 (tf060), both run in this study; exact two-sided McNemar (one test, no correction); ratio of minutes per correct answer tf125/tf060 with a paired bootstrap 95% interval (10,000 resamples, seed 2026), 40 minutes per task at most
M1.rule: accuracy significantly lower (p < 0.05, tf125 worse) -> do not upgrade; else CI upper < 1 -> 1.2.5 faster; else CI lower > 1 -> 1.2.5 slower; otherwise -> no speed difference detected, stay on 0.6.0
M1.reading: no speed difference detected: stay on 0.6.0 (accuracy: no difference detected)

M1_tasks_both_engines_ran.what: the same test on the tasks both engines ran (all 400: no block failed)
